name: Pavan Khind
description: Pavan Khind is a mountain pass in the Sahyadri range, famous for the legendary Battle of Pavan Khind (1660) where Baji Prabhu Deshpande and his men made a heroic last stand to ensure Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj's escape from Siddi Johar's forces.
historicalSignificance: Site of the Battle of Pavan Khind (1660), a symbol of supreme sacrifice and Maratha valor.

landmarks.name: Pavan Khind Memorial
landmarks.description: Statues of Baji Prabhu Deshpande and his Bandal Sena.

landmarks.name: Battle Site
landmarks.description: The narrow pass where the legendary battle took place.

reviews: A place that gives goosebumps to every Maratha!
The memorial is inspiring and the pass is scenic.
